title: The Road
desc: A big road project throws the lives of Meera, a news writer, and Maya, a teacher, into chaos, changing everything they know.

title: Rowdy Rakshak
desc: A special agent is assigned to protect the prime minister, who later gets assassinated. He is tasked with finding the group responsible for the assassination.

title: Sheshnaag
desc: Pritam and Banu, two shape-shifting snakes in human form, seek protection from a young man when an evil priest tries to hunt them down and use them in a ritual for wealth and immortality.

title: Suriya
desc: An honest and uncompromising DCP takes on a businessman and his goons who are involved in illegal dumping of toxic waste and causing serious health concerns.

title: The Kerala Story
desc: Shalini, a former nursing student from Kerala, who later becomes the wife of a terrorist, testifies her life story and her journey from being a naive girl to another victim of terrorism.
